name: Elixis-W
summary: India's first home-grown wheeled humanoid, built by warehouse-automation firm Addverb and shown at the AI Impact Summit and LogiMAT India in 2026. It skips legs deliberately — a wheeled base covers warehouse distances faster — and pairs dual arms and five-fingered hands with 3D LiDAR, stereo depth and Jetson compute for visual-SLAM navigation.
notable: Designed for intralogistics rather than general-purpose work

links.title: Addverb launches Elixis-W, India's first wheeled humanoid robot
